content.short: Yup aggregates all of Web3's social content in one place.
content.description: Yup consolidates Web3's social content from Farcaster, Lens, Mirror, NFTs, POAPs, and more into one place. It rewards users for contributing and curating content, using the Yup Protocol, a decentralized, semi-autonomous social consensus protocol, to determine the social value of posts and assets. By creating a shared valuation layer for online expression, Yup surfaces valued content and recognizes the contributions of creators and curators across the Web3 ecosystem.
